proofs.text: Build the brief for a rule that needs a model review without passing `--ai`; verify the recorded review reads `not available` and the rendering still carries a `Model review` heading
With no `claude` on the path, build the brief with `--ai`; verify the recorded review reads `not available`
Build the brief for a low-risk rule with `--ai` and a probe that raises if the path is searched; verify no model is reached and the recorded review is `none`

rule_text: The model review runs only when the caller passes `--ai` and the rule needs one; without it, and with no model on the path, the brief records `not available`

tests.body:
def test_without_ai_the_brief_says_not_available(self, reviewed):
        built = build(reviewed, 'RULE-2')
        assert built['ai_review'] == 'not available'
        assert 'Model review' in brief_module.render_brief(built)
tests.name: test_without_ai_the_brief_says_not_available

tests.body:
def test_with_no_claude_on_the_path_it_says_not_available(
            self, reviewed, monkeypatch):
        monkeypatch.setattr(brief_module.shutil, 'which', lambda name: None)
        assert build(reviewed, 'RULE-2', ai=True)['ai_review'] == (
            'not available')
tests.name: test_with_no_claude_on_the_path_it_says_not_available
